title: The Day of the Mud Boot Treaty
skyStory: A quarter-lit moon is drifting through Pisces like a rowboat nobody bothered to tie up. It hums sea shanties under its breath and keeps losing the chorus. Mars wants to steer. Saturn insists on reading the tide chart first, out loud, with footnotes. Below them, every driveway in Atlantic Canada has turned to pudding, and the moon considers this a personal achievement.

reading: May arrives with mud up to the ankles and the Fire Tiger is thrilled about it. You will want to start a garden, a shed, a podcast and a backyard choir before noon. The [[Knight of Wands]] clears its throat. One. Pick the shed, or better, pick the boot rack by the cabin door that has been a pile of boots since March.

Around 4:40 pm a neighbour will offer to help with something you were going to do alone. This is the test. The Tiger's instinct is to say no thanks, I've got it, while carrying eleven things. Say yes instead. Hand over the lightest thing. Watch how nobody falls over and the sky stays exactly where it was.
joel.mission: Scrape the mud off one pair of boots completely, then line them up by the door like they are reporting for duty.
joel.omen: A robin tugging a worm that will not come loose. Patience wins today; let things come out at their own speed.
joel.stoneWhy: grounding for a very muddy day

reading: The Pisces moon is wading in your favourite water today, the shallow kind by the shore where the stones are warm on top and cold underneath. Your intuition is running at full Life Path 11 strength, so trust the first odd feeling of the morning. It knows something about the afternoon.

At some point a small plan will wobble: a message arrives late, a meeting slides an hour. The Wood Rat in you will see the new shape before anyone else does, and you will quietly rearrange three things so the whole day lands softer. Nobody will notice. That is the point, and also slightly annoying. Tell one person what you did.
nancy.mission: Find the muddiest patch on your walk and step around it with exaggerated ballet form, arms included.
nancy.omen: A weathervane pointing the opposite way from the wind. Someone is about to ask your advice; give them the short version.
nancy.elementWhy: Pisces moon, high tide in you

together.text: Each of you photograph the most heroic puddle you can find today and send it without comment. The other must name it like a lake on an old map. Bonus point for anything that ends in Reach, Narrows or Lesser Sorrow.

game.intro: Mud season just signed a treaty with the boot rack, and Saturn demands a front page. Fill the blank. Hold the presses.
game.headline: MUD BOOTS SIGN PEACE TREATY WITH FRONT HALL, ___ REFUSES TO ATTEND
